from solution import common_in_nested_lists


def test_issue_example_exact():
    """Check example from issue finds common elements as [18, 12]."""
    # common to all 3: 12 in all, 18 in all => {12, 18} ordered as [18, 12]
    assert common_in_nested_lists([[12, 18, 23, 25, 45], [7, 12, 18, 24, 28], [1, 5, 8, 12, 15, 16, 18]]) == [18, 12]


def test_issue_no_common():
    """Check nested lists with no common elements return empty."""
    # 1,2 vs 3,4 share nothing => []
    assert sorted(common_in_nested_lists([[1, 2], [3, 4]])) == []


def test_issue_single_common():
    """Check three nested lists with one common element find it."""
    # only 2 in all three: 2==2==2 => [2]
    assert sorted(common_in_nested_lists([[1, 2, 3], [2, 3, 4], [2, 5, 6]])) == [2]


def test_issue_all_common():
    """Check identical nested lists return all common elements."""
    # 1 in both, 2 in both, 3 in both => [1, 2, 3]
    assert sorted(common_in_nested_lists([[1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 3]])) == [1, 2, 3]


def test_issue_empty_inner():
    """Check nested lists with an empty inner list return empty."""
    # 1,2,3 intersect empty = nothing => []
    assert sorted(common_in_nested_lists([[1, 2, 3], []])) == []


def test_issue_single_empty():
    """Check single empty inner list has no common elements."""
    # empty has no elements => []
    assert sorted(common_in_nested_lists([[]])) == []


def test_issue_single_sublist():
    """Check single nested list returns its common elements."""
    # only one list, all of 5,6,7 are common => [5, 6, 7]
    assert sorted(common_in_nested_lists([[5, 6, 7]])) == [5, 6, 7]


def test_issue_duplicates_unique():
    """Check duplicated values in nested lists appear once in common elements."""
    # {1,1,2,2} cap {1,2,2,3} = {1,2} => [1, 2]
    assert sorted(common_in_nested_lists([[1, 1, 2, 2], [1, 2, 2, 3]])) == [1, 2]


def test_issue_negative_zero():
    """Check nested lists with negative numbers and zero find common elements."""
    # -1 in all three, 0 in all three, 1 not in 2nd/3rd => [-1, 0]
    assert sorted(common_in_nested_lists([[-1, 0, 1], [0, -1, 2], [0, -1, 5]])) == [-1, 0]


def test_contract_returns_list():
    """Check function returns a list as shown in the example."""
    # 2 in both [1,2] and [2,3] => [2], type must be list
    result = common_in_nested_lists([[1, 2], [2, 3]])
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_contract_no_mutation():
    """Check function does not mutate the given nested lists."""
    # input [[1,2,3],[2,3,4]] must stay [[1,2,3],[2,3,4]] after call
    data = [[1, 2, 3], [2, 3, 4]]
    common_in_nested_lists(data)
    assert data == [[1, 2, 3], [2, 3, 4]]
